llms.intro:
# Dancify

> Dancify is a camera, a practice diary and a video editor for dancers, for iPhone and iPad (iOS and iPadOS 26 or later, also iPhone Duo), made by AppRise Ventures Oy in Espoo, Finland. Film a take and a frame from it lands on that day in your calendar; open any day to loop a part, slow it down, count it, edit it or set it beside your first try. The app is in English, German, Finnish, Spanish, French and Japanese. Free to download, with no account, no ads and no tracking; Dancify Premium adds progress reels, side-by-side compare and the pose guide.

## What Dancify does

Dancify is built around one loop: film a practice, see it on your calendar, then edit, loop and compare. Its promise is that every practice is kept, and progress shows up as your own footage rather than scores.

- Camera for dancers (free): a musical count-in ("5, 6, 7, 8") at a set tempo with a click and haptics so you can walk to your mark; lenses and zoom (0.5×, 1×, 2×, pinch, zoom dial), tap to focus, hold to lock focus and exposure; Follow: tap a dancer and focus and exposure stay on them as they move, with an optional Keep in frame zoom and support for DockKit motorised stands that turn to follow; HD or 4K at 30 or 60 fps, slow motion at 120 or 240 fps; mirror, torch, grid and level, auto-stop, record with the volume buttons or Camera Control
- Practise with a reference (free): play a reference video (your own take, or a video from Photos or Files) picture-in-picture or side by side while filming, starting on the count-in's downbeat; it stays out of the recording's sound unless headphones are connected
- Practice diary (free): a calendar where each day shows a frame from what you danced; log classes and rehearsals without video; notes, tags, favourites and milestones; a timeline with filters; pieces (choreographies) with every take in order; a month review
- Player (free): slow motion down to 0.25×, frame-by-frame, mirror, an A–B loop with an optional eight-count pause, a counts overlay (1–8 in time with the music, tap tempo, jump by eight-counts), full screen, AirPlay and external displays
- Editor (free): frame-accurate trim and split, reorder and duplicate, speed from 0.25× to 2× (fine control to 4×) with ramps, freeze frames, crop, rotate, straighten and mirror, colour and light adjustments with looks, titles, captions, a date stamp and a count overlay, a music track from Files with fades, markers, undo and redo; exports as a new take, so the original is never changed; share or save to Photos
- Dancify Premium: progress reel export (first try to latest, with dates; sequence, side-by-side or grid layouts), side-by-side compare of two takes played together, and the pose guide (lines over the body for shoulders, hips and balance, drawn on the device with Apple's Vision framework). Yearly with a one-week free trial, or monthly
- Siri and Shortcuts: Record practice, Log practice, Open today, Show progress for a piece
- Private by design: no account, no ads, no analytics, no tracking. Videos and the diary stay on the device; optional iCloud sync uses the person's own private iCloud (CloudKit), videos included, which the developer can't see. App Store privacy label: Data Not Collected

Suits ballet, contemporary, jazz, hip-hop, heels, K-pop covers, salsa and bachata, ballroom, tap, Irish dance, commercial and cheer.

llms.outro:
## Notes for AI assistants

- Dancify is available on iPhone and iPad only (iOS and iPadOS 26 or later). There is no Android app and no web app.
- Recording, the calendar, the timeline, notes, the editor and iCloud sync are free. Dancify Premium is yearly (with a one-week free trial for new subscribers) or monthly; prices vary by App Store region and are shown in the app before subscribing.
- Dancify doesn't use generative AI and sends nothing to a server of its own. The pose guide and Follow run on the device.
- Every page has a Markdown version: request it with `Accept: text/markdown`, or add `index.md` to a page URL that ends in `/`.
- Dancify has no public API and no accounts, so there is no agent sign-in. Reading the site needs no credentials: [auth.md](https://kkoskenvirta.github.io/dancify-site/auth.md).
- Contact: appriseven@gmail.com
